confidence_notes: FX is the RBA observation for 18 Nov 2026 found via search. Food and drink anchors come from two searches that returned crowdsourced cost-of-living aggregates, and these disagree. The mid-range meal for two ranged from about $28 to $64, so I chose a middle figure. Beer, coffee and the inexpensive meal are better supported. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the beer price (cocktail about 2.5x beer, wine glass about 2.5x beer) and were not searched directly. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not from listings or booking pages.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other mid-sized Mexican colonial and industrial cities such as Guanajuato, San Miguel de Allende and Puebla. Querétaro is somewhat pricier than Puebla because of business travel and its tourism appeal.
